researchCreate.note: The memory queue only works with a worker in the same process (local development). Configure QSTASH_TOKEN and WORKER_URL for production.

jobDetail.note: Research is still running. Poll again shortly.

database.note: Set DATABASE_URL to persist jobs, runs, evidence and reports.

s3.note: Set S3_BUCKET, S3_REGION, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for durable artefacts.

filesystem.note: Artefacts written next to the process; not shared across instances.

qstash.notes: Set QSTASH_TOKEN and WORKER_URL to deliver jobs to an independent worker.

workerAuth.note: The worker endpoint refuses all deliveries until WORKER_SECRET or a QStash signing key is configured.

memory.warning: The memory queue cannot deliver jobs across serverless instances; production requires QStash.

marketObservations.note: Observations are per serverless instance and reset on cold start.
